verdict.rationale: The Intel spec-page excerpts in the pack give only ECC support and the 36M cache and clock figures. They contain no first-party memory type, maximum capacity, channel count or bandwidth figure. The DDR5-6400 rated speed and CUDIMM support appear only in third-party reviews, which are not the vendor's own numbers this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can size memory-bound workloads from the vendor's own numbers — published memory type, capacity ceiling, and bandwidth (or spec detail complete enough to derive it)
